1946, June 21
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
SERAPHIC MASS ASSOCIATION for the support of The Capuchin Foreign Missions
June 21st, 1946
Dear Friends of the Missions- Mr. & Mrs. Joseph Geraci. God bless you and yours.
(following is a printed message.)
May the Lord give you His peace!
I wish to thank you sincerely for your kind alms for the Capuchin Foreign Missions. I am sure that the prayers of the missionaries will ascend to the Throne of God for your welfare.
- The certificate of enrollment are inclosed herewith.
Gratefully yours in Christ,
(signed) Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. Praised be Jesus Christ!
(handwritten)
Many thanks for your favor of June 12th Praised be Jesus Christ over
(other side)
June 21st 1946 Praised be Jesus Christ
God bless you Dear Mrs. Geraci. Yes, Mrs. Geraci, Your letter to Brooklyn was forwarde to me shortly. Noted the holy Masses as requeste and do trust that everything comes according to God's holy designs. How wonderful are His ways -- and His mercy is above all His works. Blessed be His divine Providence!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
